mapper.select: SELECT A.DETAIL_CODE_ID FROM CM_CODE_DETAIL A WHERE A.CODE_ID = 'CMMNCODE.581' AND A.CMPNY_CD = 'CMMN' AND A.DETAIL_CODE_VALUE = #{detailCodeValue} AND A.USE_FL = 'Y' LIMIT 1

SELECT STYLE_ID AS styleId , CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , STYLE_NAME AS styleName , STYLE_TY AS styleTy , HTML_TEMPLATE AS htmlTemplate , CSS_TEMPLATE AS cssTemplate , JS_TEMPLATE AS jsTemplate , USE_FL AS useFl , CREATION_ID AS creationId , DATE_FORMAT(CREATION_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS creationDt , UPDATE_ID AS updateId , DATE_FORMAT(UPDATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateDt FROM CM_WIDGET_STYLE WHERE STYLE_ID = #{styleId} AND CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd}
SELECT CONCAT('STYLE-', LPAD(IFNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(STYLE_ID, 7) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) + 1, 5, '0')) FROM CM_WIDGET_STYLE WHERE STYLE_ID REGEXP '^STYLE-[0-9]+$' AND CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd}

SELECT HTML_TEMPLATE AS htmlTemplate , CSS_TEMPLATE AS cssTemplate , JS_TEMPLATE AS jsTemplate FROM CM_WIDGET_STYLE WHERE STYLE_TY = #{styleTy} AND CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND USE_FL = 'Y' ORDER BY STYLE_ID ASC LIMIT 1
